urteile.grund: Composite «u. ref.: Zemis …; SH …» with two parts. The AcroForm has two fields for it, Zemis_nr and SH, and both identify the person whose dossier the Migrationsamt holds. eCH-0044 (Genehmigt) has personIdentification (id 809, type personIdentificationType), which holds localPersonId and otherPersonId. The catalogue has no global element of the key-only type, so the composite takes this container, as the person composites with a ZEMIS part do (474 «Erwerbstätige Person», 585 «Personalien») and as forms 26, 132–137 and 237 do. eCH-0058 ourBusinessReferenceId is not used because both parts are person keys, not a business case reference. The row is currently empty.

The ZEMIS number is the federal (SEM) person number from a system outside the canton, not the canton's own key. Every ZEMIS field the databank has already mapped uses eCH-0044 otherPersonId in the context personIdentificationKeyOnlyType: field «ZEMIS-Nummer/ZEMIS-NR.» on forms 497 and 506–513, and part «ZEMIS Nr.» on form 474. The ZEMIS points on forms 584–587 are still unmapped. The element exists verbatim in eCH-0044. The part is currently unmapped.

«SH» is the Schaffhausen Migrationsamt's own number for the person, the key of the local system. The same SH-Nummer next to the ZEMIS-Nummer on forms 508–513 is mapped to eCH-0044 localPersonId (context personIdentificationKeyOnlyType). The element exists verbatim. The part is currently unmapped.

The place Schaffhausen is preprinted. The only fillable box is the AcroForm field «Datum» (data_type date), the calendar date on which the declaration is issued. In the corpus, date-only signing or issue fields take eCH-0058 messageDate (Genehmigt, headerType): «Datum» on forms 477–479, 492–494, 496, 498, 539, 545, 549, 563, 565 and 573–575. eCH-0119 locationAndDate is a combined place-and-date string and does not fit a date-only field. I searched the catalogue for a signature, issue or declaration date element (name LIKE signat/issue/declaration/consent/documentDate). It only has buildingPermitIssueDate and the eCH-0260 signature booleans, and none of them fits. The row is currently empty.

This composite holds the declaring person's surname and first name, in two separate AcroForm boxes («Name», «Vorname»). Its parts carry eCH-0044 officialName and firstName, so the parent takes the container eCH-0044 personIdentification (id 809), as the identical composite «Name, Vorname» on form 78 does. The parent row is currently empty.

The value was propagated (ech_herkunft 'propagiert', element id 800, personIdentificationLightType). NAME is the official surname of the person releasing the doctors from confidentiality, so eCH-0044 officialName is right. Form 78 maps «Name» inside «Name, Vorname» the same way.

The value was propagated (ech_herkunft 'propagiert', element id 801, personIdentificationLightType). Vorname is the same person's first name, so eCH-0044 firstName is right. Form 78 maps it the same way.
